categories.main_business_segments: Great China Metal Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in manufacturing metal packaging containers including aluminum cans, iron cans, aluminum and iron easy-open lids, and plastic stretch films. The company also engages in mold manufacturing, machinery and equipment manufacturing, and plastic product manufacturing. It serves mainly the food and beverage packaging industry with a diversified product portfolio including aluminum two-piece cans, three-piece iron cans, and LLDPE plastic films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced automated and computerized production lines for metal can manufacturing, including processes such as aluminum coil inspection, cup forming, can body shaping, trimming, washing, printing, coating, internal spraying, necking, flanging, inspection, and packaging. It also employs specialized coating and forming techniques for aluminum and iron lids. The firm emphasizes energy-saving and low-carbon technologies, including the development of aTULC cans with PET laminated aluminum to reduce environmental impact and improve food safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Great China Metal serves primarily the food and beverage industries, providing packaging solutions for products such as beer, soft drinks, juices, carbonated beverages, tea, coffee, sports drinks, and canned foods. Its customers include domestic and international beverage and food manufacturers, with a focus on quality and safety standards. The company also targets industrial packaging markets with its plastic stretch films for bundling and pallet packaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and Mainland China, with significant sales in both regions. It has established production and sales bases in major metropolitan areas in China and Vietnam to expand its presence in Southeast Asia. Domestic sales account for approximately 95% of revenue, while exports constitute about 5%, with ongoing efforts to develop international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Great China Metal operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing metal packaging containers from raw aluminum and tinplate materials sourced globally. It maintains a high degree of vertical integration with in-house mold and component manufacturing, enabling rapid response to customer design changes and cost control. The company relies on international suppliers for aluminum alloy coils and tinplate sheets, positioning it as a key packaging supplier to downstream food and beverage producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on continuous improvement of production technology and process automation to enhance quality and reduce costs. R&D priorities include developing new can shapes and sizes, energy systems integration, and carbon reduction equipment. It actively pursues sustainable packaging innovations such as the aTULC PET laminated aluminum cans to meet environmental and food safety standards. Expansion of overseas production bases and strengthening supply chain sustainability are also strategic goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of metal packaging containers and plastic films. The company sells directly to food and beverage manufacturers and industrial customers. It also derives income from overseas subsidiaries and joint ventures involved in packaging production. The revenue model is based on volume sales, with pricing influenced by raw material costs and market competition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Great China Metal is the only comprehensive packaging container manufacturer in Taiwan with a full range of aluminum and iron cans and lids. It holds a significant market share domestically and maintains competitive positioning through product diversity, technological capability, and international expansion. Competitors include other regional metal packaging producers, but the company's integrated manufacturing and R&D capabilities provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$8.37 billion, a slight decrease of 0.44% from the previous year, with a net profit after tax of NT$492 million, reflecting a 12.25% increase. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio around 27%, strong liquidity ratios, and improving profitability metrics. R&D expenditure has been increasing, with plans to invest about NT$20 million in 2025. The company shows steady growth with cautious outlook due to external economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Great China Metal emphasizes high-quality, diversified packaging solutions tailored to customer needs in the food and beverage industry. Its products offer excellent gas and light barrier properties, superior sealing, and environmental sustainability through high recyclability. The company differentiates itself by integrating advanced manufacturing technologies, in-house mold production for rapid customization, and pioneering low-carbon packaging innovations like the aTULC can. Its strong customer orientation and international presence further enhance its competitive advantage.
